mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_webhook_pause_receipts (tenant_id, request_id, actor_ref, subscription_id) VALUES (#{tenant}, CAST(#{request} AS uuid), #{actor}, #{subscription}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE nw_webhook_pause_receipts SET changed = #{changed} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid) AND changed IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT actor_ref, subscription_id, changed FROM nw_webhook_pause_receipts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND request_id = CAST(#{request} AS uuid)
